scope: Project-specific 1024x1024 default-schedule regression limits; not an official ComfyUI standard or a universal image-quality guarantee.
exact: Metadata, complete tensor-key set, shapes, dtypes, all integers/booleans, prompt embeddings, semantic features, VQ token IDs, editing input, initial latent/noise, sigmas and first-step x remain exact; non-finite values always fail.
rationale: Limits are calibrated from six seed-42 official/native comparisons and twelve full-weight DiT probes. Each category uses a rounded margin above its observed errors. Image MAE and RMSE, not the [0,1] maximum alone, constrain visible differences. These limits are frozen before independent holdouts; a holdout failure must be investigated, not automatically used to enlarge a limit.

holdout.prompt: A ceramic teapot beside two oranges on a wooden table, soft morning light.
holdout.editing_prompt: Render the geometric image as a soft pastel illustration.
holdout.note: New seed and prompts test the diffusion and editing limits independently. VQ baseline token/features remain exact; the deterministic VQ prompt path is not claimed as a new holdout.
